stories.title: Hamilton Concedes 2026 F1 Title After Madring DNF — Brake Failure Ends Championship Hopes

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
Lewis Hamilton has conceded the 2026 F1 title.

Lap 7 at Madring: brake failure. First DNF of the season. Zero points.

Now 101 behind Antonelli with 233 available. Technically possible. Practically over.

"No stopping" Antonelli. 🏆

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Hamilton's Madring brake failure in numbers:

- Lap 7 DNF (first of 2026)
- Qualified P4, finished last
- 101 points behind Antonelli
- Only Leclerc scored for Ferrari (P4)
- McLaren now just 52 pts behind Ferrari in Constructors'

Ferrari's worst weekend of 2026.
